scope: GF8 legacy-high pure-AVX2 encode for T=32 and exact 64-byte public shards
implementation: Append an optional pure-AVX2 GF8 inverse-radix-two range callback to the immutable backend operation table; scalar, SSSE3, AVX-512, GFNI, and GF8-disabled builds publish null.
For the final inverse layer of each T=32 message block, broadcast the fixed nibble tables once and process all sixteen shard pairs in one exact-64-byte callback, including the XOR-accumulating form.
Thread an exact-public-64-byte eligibility bit separately from internal pass bytes so ragged inputs and larger tiled calls cannot inherit the policy.
Keep the callback high-rate-only, pure-AVX2-only, and exact-B64-only; low profile, sparse scheduling semantics, all other byte counts, and every other backend retain the mature transform.
Null the callback in trace instrumentation and validate it with startup known-answer tests before runtime publication.

static_attribution.interpretation: This candidate removes repeated dispatch, table preparation, and vzeroupper overhead. It intentionally does not claim to remove a shard-data pass.

hardening: predeclared full SHA-256 for candidate, control, and exact main
selector words 1 and 2 at the same initialized-data object
full-file equality after normalizing only the selector object and GNU build-id section
read-only mirrored Python dependency closure revalidated after execution
incremental partial-round retention and captured failure streams

authoritative_campaign.allowed_full_file_differences: 20 GNU build-id descriptor bytes plus one selector byte
authoritative_campaign.performance_statistic: geometric mean of one balanced log contrast per independent mirrored-ABBA round with a two-sided Student-t 95 percent confidence interval

selected_region_summary.interpretation: Every selected cell improved over both comparators in the observed statistic. Every same-source gain and both primary exact-main gains are statistically credible at 95 percent.

credible_subthreshold_regressions.interpretation: A reproducible roughly half-percent same-text layout cost is retained and remains below the two-percent promotion threshold.

feature_reduced_builds: GF8-only field mask 1 with T32 direct-oracle test
GF16-only field mask 2 with no GF8 dependency
independent_oracles: same-binary mature transform with the range disabled
contract_cases: ragged and larger tiled public byte counts
unaligned source and destination buffers with guards
undersized scratch rejection and failure atomicity

resource_policy.reason_for_less_than_available_paralleli: Prior sessions exhausted memory during parallel compiler and sanitizer workloads. Builds and correctness gates were therefore serialized under resident-memory caps. Authoritative cache-sensitive timing intentionally used one physical core and reserved its SMT sibling.

disposition: Promoted for the exact GF8 legacy-high pure-AVX2 T=32/B64 region. Both original gaps now credibly beat exact Leopard main, all 24 selected shapes beat same-source control, and no unselected neighbor violates the two-percent regression rule.
next_candidates: If a residual prevalidated-versus-public gap remains, evaluate a narrow exact-B64/T32 packed public terminal or four-pointer-at-a-time packed-layout verifier.
Otherwise evaluate an exact-B64 no-spill radix-eight source-stage kernel that removes one 32-row in-place pass per full message block.

A prefix-aware fused final-three-layer forward T32 kernel is secondary; kill either arithmetic candidate on vector spills, more than about 2 KiB new text, less than five-percent target gain, or more than two-percent neighboring regression.
